emails.subject: True Joy Birthing — featuring Eden Doula Services on our Leesburg page
emails.body:
Hi Anna,

I hope you're doing well! I'm reaching out from True Joy Birthing, a free birth plan platform that helps expecting moms prepare for their births. We've just published a Leesburg / Lake County city page (https://truejoybirthing.com/doula/leesburg-fl) and we've featured Eden Doula Services as one of the area's trusted doulas.

Here's what we have listed for you:
- Credential: DONA-Trained Birth & Postpartum Doula
- Cost range: $1,200-$1,800 (estimated — your actual birth package is $1,400)
- Services: Birth Doula, Postpartum Doula, Childbirth Education, Placenta Encapsulation
- Service area: Leesburg, Mount Dora, Lake County, Central Florida

We'd love to verify the details with you and make sure everything is accurate. We're also happy to update your photo, add a direct link to your booking page, or adjust any pricing if you'd like.

If you're interested, we can also feature your reviews or add a note about your midwife assistant work. Just reply to this email and let me know!

Warmly,
The True Joy Birthing Team
https://truejoybirthing.com
